diag_note: Only read-only test commands are sent to the card. If reading fails, this output helps to narrow down the cause – it contains no driver data.
w_coverage: Record period incomplete: {count} of {days} days without data (available from {start} to {end}) – the current day and the preceding days must be carried
set_coverage: Check coverage of the record period
set_coverage_days: Record period in days (in addition to the current day)
vu_due: overdue – {count} days ago (at least every 90 days)
note_no_mf: The card does not allow the master file to be selected ({sw}); the identification files EF_ICC and EF_IC are therefore missing from the archive. The evaluation is not affected.
msg_read_warnings:
Some files could not be read:
{items}
msg_pcsc_missing: The PC/SC service is not reachable. Install and start pcscd on the host (e.g. “sudo apt install pcscd” and “sudo systemctl enable --now pcscd.socket”).
msg_no_card: There is no card in the reader.
msg_empty: The archive is empty. Insert a driver card and choose “Read driver card” – or import a DDD file.
msg_verify_bad: {bad} of {count} files are changed or missing.
set_unknown_rest: Count periods without inserted card as rest
set_arbzg: Check German Working Hours Act (§ 21a ArbZG, Directive 2002/15/EC)
set_restart: A new archive folder is used after restarting.
disclaimer: This evaluation is a working aid and does not replace a legal review. All times in UTC. Card signatures are stored but not verified against the ERCA root.
v_break: Missing break: {drive} driving without sufficient break (max. 4:30 h, then 45 min or 15 + 30 min)
v_daily_drive: Daily driving time {value} exceeds the limit of {limit}
v_daily_drive_ext: Daily driving time {value}: already extension no. {count} to 10 h this week (max. 2)
v_daily_rest: Daily rest not met: longest rest {value} in the period starting {start} (min. {limit})
v_reduced_count: Reduced daily rest no. {count} since the last weekly rest (max. 3)
v_weekly_rest_late: Weekly rest too late: {value} since the end of the previous weekly rest (max. 144:00 h)
v_weekly_rest_comp: Compensation for reduced weekly rest ({deficit}) not taken by {deadline}
i_weekly_rest_comp_open: Compensation for reduced weekly rest ({deficit}) due by {deadline}
w_two_reduced: Two consecutive reduced weekly rests – only allowed in international goods transport outside the state of establishment
v_fortnight_drive: Driving time over two weeks {value} exceeds 90:00 h
v_arbzg_6h: {value} of working time without a break of at least 15 min (max. 6:00 h)
w_arbzg_avg: Average weekly working time {value} over {count} weeks (limit 48:00 h)
w_download_due: Last driver card download {count} days ago – required at least every 28 days
w_download_never: No download time is stored on the card
w_card_expiry: Driver card expires on {date} – apply for renewal in time
i_gap: No records from {start} to {end} – proof required (manual entry, leave, sickness)
i_ferry_rest: Rest period on ferry/train interrupted {count} time(s) ({value} in total) – permitted under Art. 9(1), provided a sleeper cabin is available
v_ferry_limit: Rest period on ferry/train interrupted {count} times ({value} in total) – at most two interruptions totalling 1:00 h are allowed
v_ferry_reduced: Interruption on ferry/train with only {value} of rest – allowed only for a regular daily rest (11:00 h) or a weekly rest period
v_ferry_weekly_short: Regular weekly rest interrupted on ferry/train, crossing lasts only {value} – at least {limit} required
i_ferry_open: Ferry/train crossing from {start} without end marker – end estimated as {end}
set_ferry: Apply the ferry and train derogation (Art. 9)
ev_6: Last card session not correctly closed
note_violations: Violations only. Warnings and notes are in the “Warnings” tab.
note_warnings: Warnings and notes. Violations are in the “Violations” tab.
note_remaining: As of {time} UTC – calculated from the available data. Driving without a card is not included.
meter_until_weekly: still free until the weekly rest
access_intro: The archive holds personal data. Without protection the files sit readable in the archive folder – on a shared user account that means anyone who opens the folder.
access_on: Encrypt the archive and ask for a password
access_warning: Without the password and without the recovery key the data is lost for good. There is no back door. The retention duty still applies – keep the key away from this computer.
access_lock_at_start: Stay locked when the program starts
access_hint: The password protects the files while the archive is locked. While it is unlocked, anyone at this running computer can read the data. Against access with administrator rights only full-disk encryption helps.
ask_protect: All archive files will now be encrypted. Continue?
ask_unprotect: All archive files will be stored unencrypted again. Continue?
lock_off: No access protection. The archive files lie unencrypted in the archive folder.
lock_open: Archive unlocked – locks itself after {minutes} min without use.
lock_closed: Archive locked. The files are encrypted.
msg_wrong_password: Password or recovery key does not match.
msg_password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
msg_password_short: The password must have at least 8 characters.
recovery_text: Write this key down and keep it away from this computer. It opens the archive if the password is lost. Without it and without the password the data is lost for good.
recovery_file:
TachoArchiv – recovery key
Created: {date} UTC

{key}

This key opens the archive without the password. Keep it away from this computer.
msg_empty_locked: The archive is locked. Unlock it in the “Archive” tab.
access_missing: The package python3-cryptography is missing. Install it and restart TachoArchiv to use encryption.
pdf_full_note: Card data, findings, weeks, days, events
pdf_only_note: Card data and the violations table – nothing else
pdf_note_language: The program stays in {current} – only the report is written in the chosen language.
msg_sig_ok: All {count} files: signature confirmed. That shows the data is unchanged since it was read and comes from a card with a valid certificate. It does not replace certified control software.
msg_sig_bad: {bad} of {count} files: the signature does not match the data. Check where the file came from before you use it.
msg_sig_partial: {count} of {total} files confirmed; the rest could not be checked (the “Signature” column gives the reason).
certdiag_note: Structure of the certificates in the newest download. The output holds no driver data – only identifiers, lengths and check results. It helps when the signature check does not work with a real card.
msg_sig_partial_root: {count} files: data unchanged and the card certificate confirmed against the stated member state. The chain up to the European root is open because no ERCA root certificate is stored.
msg_manual_missing: The user manual was not found. It is in the source package under doc/bedienungsanleitung.md.
